text:
natalie: morning sync 1: ran a quick speculative bring-up on the new draft model (ozma-70b-quant-lite). Setup: spec branch sampler + 2-stage prefetch; small budget 0.22. Quick numbers: tokens/sec +1.6x, p50 latency ~140ms -> 85ms, p99 +3%.

tom: good start. any quality deltas on our sequence benchmarks?

natalie: short summary from bench-bot below. full artifacts uploaded.

bench-bot: auto-report (500 prompts, mixed):
- em: baseline 46.0% -> spec 45.6% (-0.4)
- rouge-L: 62.7 -> 62.5 (-0.2)
- ppl(1k): 11.7 -> 11.9 (+0.2)
- p50 latency: 140ms -> 85ms (-39%)
- p99 latency: 870ms -> 900ms (+3.4%)
- tokens/sec: 640 -> 1024 (+60%)
(artifacts: s3://redwood-shadow/3012349999/report.json)

emily: where are regressions concentrated?

natalie: mostly on multi-step planning prompts and one-shot code transforms. single-turn chat and extractive QA unaffected. I grabbed 8 worst examples and stored logits + accept_mask: s3://redwood-shadow/3012349999/worst8.jsonl

tom: any quick runtime knobs to try before wide sweep?

natalie: two small runtime tweaks: 1) add confidence smoothing window=2 (simple avg) 2) conservative accept: require top-1 gap >0.14 when lookahead>=4. I tested locally with 1k sample; EM improved by ~0.2 vs raw spec.

emily: nice. did you change quant kernels?

natalie: no kernel changes this run. however, we observed slight variance between q4_0 and our q4_k-derived pack; will run both. ops-bot flagged GPU mem + transient oom on 40G when lookahead=8 + batch16.

ops-bot: alert: one node OOM during stress test. recommendation: reduce batch to 8 or cap lookahead to 6 for 40G pools.

tom: plan: run a 5k sweep varying budget in {0.15,0.22,0.3} x lookahead in {3,6} x smoothing on/off. also repro on q4_0 vs q4_k configs. target finish EOD. If we can get EM hit <0.3 and keep >=1.4x tokens/sec, we can staging-canary low-risk routes.

natalie: putting runs in queue now. PR for conservative-accept + smoothing: https://git.internal/rw/spec/3012-conservative. will post full metrics here when done. ping me if you want earlier access.

emily: also add a tiny human eval for the worst 8 examples, just to double-check whether the regressions are acceptable.

bench-bot: queued sweep jobs; eta ~6h.

tom: thanks all. small ask: tag any code-gen failures with reason labels (truncated/structure-loss/hallucination) so we can aggregate patterns later.

natalie: will do. closing for now.
